name: run
describe: Implement a GitHub issue end-to-end: branch, code, commit, open PR.

inputs.name: base
inputs.describe: Optional base branch override. Used by goal-tick's stacked-PR dispatch so each task PR forks from the previous task's head ref. Accepts any safe git ref (see resolveBaseOverride in runFlow.ts).

inputs.name: feedback
inputs.describe: Inline override carried into the run's plan context. The dashboard's Rerun action forwards its `Rerun.feedback` through this input so a re-triggered run inherits the operator's intent. Free-text leftover from comment dispatch (e.g. `@kody run please also add X`) lands here verbatim.

inputs.name: fromStage
inputs.describe: ACCEPTED BUT UNSUPPORTED. The dashboard's Rerun contract carries a `fromStage` hint (intended to restart the run from a specific flow stage), but the engine does not yet implement staged resume — providing this input has no effect beyond being preserved in the run's inputs. Documented here so a future change can wire it up without touching the dashboard contract.
